statements.statement: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope (R55)
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
CPT code 93271 (cardiac event monitoring study) was billed
The billed balance for this service is $357.79
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The denial reason is that payment for this service is bundled into another covered procedure
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the cause of syncope and manage atrial fibrillation
